Objective

Coordinate complex initiatives

Align several organizations, clarify responsibilities and coordinate their contributions to a shared undertaking.

Services for this objective

Select an offering to see what it involves.

  • Bring organizations together to deliver

    Align the participants, responsibilities and decisions in a multi-party initiative, and coordinate execution while each organization remains responsible for its work.

    4 offerings

    • Integration planning
      What we do
      Define participants, responsibilities, connections and milestones.
      What you receive
      An integration plan.
      Why this matters
      Make each participant’s contribution clear.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • Japanese and Indian firms pursuing a third-market project

      Discuss this offering

    • Participant alignment and governance
      What we do
      Develop arrangements for decisions, reporting and escalation.
      What you receive
      A governance model for participants’ agreement.
      Why this matters
      Support timely decisions across organizations.

      Discuss this offering

    • Execution coordination

      Keep separate contributions moving together.

      What we do
      Coordinate participants’ work, track progress and help address dependencies and issues across the agreed undertaking.
      What you receive
      A coordinated programme with regular progress reports.
      Why this matters
      Fewer gaps between organizations and clearer visibility of what needs attention.

      Each participant remains responsible for its own work. SetuHashi’s coordinating responsibilities match its agreed authority and scope.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Coordinating a consistent customer experience after a merger

      Discuss this offering

    • Outcome tracking
      What we do
      Track agreed business outcomes and report progress.
      What you receive
      Regular outcome reports.
      Why this matters
      Keep attention on business results, alongside delivery activity.

      Discuss this offering

    Discuss this service

Each assignment includes the offerings agreed with you. Recommendations support your decisions; customers, partners and financiers make their own decisions.
